name: Our Lovely Escape
source:
Your life is a peaceful one. Each day, you work alongside your (otherwise?) all-female workforce in the pursuit of creating otome games.

Will you complete your life with a cute girlfriend? Will you be doomed to a life of normalcy? Or...?

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/our-lovely-escape] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的生活是平静的。每天，你都会与（否则？）全女性员工一起努力创造乙女游戏。

你会和一个可爱的女朋友一起完成你的生活吗？你注定要过平凡的生活吗？或者…？

[来自[url=https://reineworks.itch.io/our-lovely-escape] itch.io[/url]]
